clues.text: This city stands on the River Seine in the west of Europe. Its old streets by the river are a World Heritage Site.
clues.narrowing: Rules out everything outside western Europe and puts the player on the River Seine.

source.quote: Parts of the city along the Seine have been designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1991.

clues.text: Winters here are cool and grey, with rain in all months of the year. Hard frost is rare, since the sea air keeps the cold mild.
clues.narrowing: Rules out hard-winter lands and dry lands; keeps the mild, wet west.

source.quote: In winter, sunshine is scarce, days are cool, and nights are cold but generally above freezing

clues.text: Clovis, a Frankish king, made this city his capital in the year 508. The city stayed the seat of kings for a long time after that.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to old royal capitals raised as a king's seat in the early Middle Ages.

source.quote: Clovis the Frank , the first king of the Merovingian dynasty , made the city his capital from 508.

clues.text: A tall iron tower went up for a great fair here in 1889. Top artists of the day panned its design, but now the world loves it.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: one famous iron tower, built for the 1889 fair, marks this city.

source.quote: it was constructed as the centrepiece of the 1889 World's Fair

clues.text: The president of France sits in this city. Both houses of its parliament sit here too.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: the president and both houses of parliament sit in this city.

source.quote: The president of France and both houses of the French Parliament sit in Paris.

reveal.blurb: River traders built a town on an island here more than 2,000 years ago, and in 508 King Clovis made it his capital. Kings, artists, and crowds at a great fair shaped the streets you see today. That iron tower from 1889 still stands over the city. Paris is the capital of France.
